subject: biology
topicDisplay: Theme D · Molecules & Cells (Replication, Protein Synthesis, Division, Water Potential)
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: DNA replication is semi-conservative because each new molecule has:
options: One original and one new strand
questions.explain: Confirmed by Meselson and Stahl.

questions.q: The enzyme that unwinds and separates DNA strands is:
questions.explain: Helicase breaks hydrogen bonds between bases.

questions.q: Free nucleotides pair with template bases according to:
questions.explain: A–T and C–G pairing ensures accurate copying.

questions.q: Transcription is the process in which:
options: A gene's DNA is copied into mRNA
questions.explain: RNA polymerase makes mRNA complementary to the template strand.

questions.q: Translation into a polypeptide occurs at the:
questions.explain: Ribosomes read codons and assemble amino acids.

questions.q: A codon is:
options: A triplet of mRNA bases coding for one amino acid
questions.explain: Each codon specifies an amino acid or a start/stop signal.

questions.q: tRNA delivers amino acids to the ribosome and pairs with mRNA using its:
questions.explain: The tRNA anticodon pairs with the complementary mRNA codon.

questions.q: The start codon is:
questions.explain: AUG codes for methionine; UAA, UAG and UGA are stop codons.

questions.q: A gene mutation is:
options: A change in the DNA base sequence
questions.explain: It may alter the protein produced.

questions.q: Sickle-cell anaemia results from a single base substitution, an example of a:
questions.explain: One base change alters one amino acid in haemoglobin.

questions.q: CRISPR-Cas9 is a technology used to:
questions.explain: It allows targeted DNA editing, raising ethical questions.

questions.q: Mitosis produces daughter nuclei that are:
questions.explain: Mitosis is used for growth, repair and asexual reproduction.

questions.q: Meiosis is a reduction division because it:
options: Halves the chromosome number to make haploid cells
questions.explain: Gametes are haploid; diploidy is restored at fertilisation.

questions.q: Genetic variation in gametes is increased by:
questions.explain: These, plus random fertilisation, generate variation.

questions.q: Cancer results from:
questions.explain: Mutations in cell-cycle genes cause unchecked division.

questions.q: Water moves by osmosis from:
options: Higher water potential to lower water potential
questions.explain: Water moves down its water potential gradient.

questions.q: A plant cell in a hypotonic solution will:
options: Take in water and become turgid
Burst like a red blood cell
questions.explain: The cell wall prevents bursting, so the cell becomes firm.

questions.q: A plant cell in a strongly hypertonic solution undergoes:
questions.explain: Water leaves and the membrane pulls away from the wall.

questions.q: If a template strand reads 3'-TAC-5', the mRNA codon is:
questions.explain: mRNA is complementary, antiparallel and uses uracil; AUG is the start codon.

questions.q: Accurate DNA replication before division ensures:
options: Each daughter cell gets a complete, correct genome
All mutations are removed from the parent
questions.explain: Replication maintains genetic continuity between cells.
